items.question: What stored energy must be relieved during lockout, and what temperature must heaters and barrels fall below?

items.question: What PPE is required for handling acids and caustics versus solvents and degreasers?
items.reference: Acids and caustics require a face shield, butyl rubber gloves and a chemical-resistant apron. Solvents and degreasers require nitrile gloves at least 0.4 mm thick and splash goggles. Gloves must be replaced immediately after any splash or visible degradation.

items.question: What detection rules indicate a process is out of statistical control?
items.reference: Investigate when any point lies beyond a control limit, 7 consecutive points fall on one side of the center line, 6 consecutive points trend up or down, or 2 of 3 points are beyond 2 sigma on the same side.
items.answer:
A process is out of statistical control when any of these detection rules is met:
- One point falls beyond a control limit.
- Seven consecutive points fall on the same side of the center line.
- Six consecutive points trend upward or downward.
- Two of three consecutive points fall beyond 2 sigma on the same side of the center line.
